description.value: Bona Manzi is a self-contained cottage on Bowen Island, British Columbia, listed on Airbnb and marketed for its ocean views and peaceful setting. The property is a separate cottage rather than a room within a host's home. Bowen Island is a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay near Vancouver, making it a possible stopover for cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast or Sea to Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Airbnb listing URL fetched successfully but only returned generic Airbnb navigation and footer pages — not the actual room listing content. The only substantive evidence is the page title: 'Enjoy ocean views & peace in our separate cottage - Guesthouses for Rent in Bowen Island, British Columbia, Canada,' which reveals the property is on Bowen Island, not Vancouver as the OSM community field states. No amenity details, bike storage information, or contact data could be extracted from the website content.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Vancouver' but the Airbnb listing title identifies the property as being in Bowen Island, British Columbia — likely a misplaced OSM node or incorrect community assignment.

Website prefetch returned only generic Airbnb navigation/footer pages; the actual listing detail page content (amenities, host description, photos) was not captured, leaving all cyclist-relevant criteria unverifiable.
This is an Airbnb self-hosted cottage with no identifiable front-desk staff, which raises questions about the 'staff know the bike procedure' criterion.
No physical address, phone number, or email available in OSM or from the website fetch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Airbnb listing appears active but the fetched content yielded no usable amenity details, making WWC criteria unverifiable. The OSM community field says 'Vancouver' while the listing is on Bowen Island — a geographic discrepancy that needs correction — and the self-hosted Airbnb model means no dedicated staff, raising doubt about bike procedure knowledge.
enrichment_extras.notes: A direct scrape or manual review of the Airbnb listing page is needed to assess bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, and other amenities before a final include/exclude decision can be made.
